# Intent Capture & Framing — Questions

## Sources

- [desc] Initial description: "Build a simple React todo app"
- [scope] Workflow-selected scope: `feature`.

## Q1. What business problem are we solving?

What is the core problem this todo app addresses, or the outcome you want it to enable?

- A. Personal task tracking — help an individual keep track of things to do
- B. Team/shared task coordination
- C. A learning or demo project to explore React
- D. Part of a larger product (a todo feature inside something bigger)
- E. Not yet defined
- X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. Personal task tracking — help an individual keep track of things to do

## Q2. Who is the customer, and what pain are they experiencing?

Who will use this app (internal/external), and what frustration does it relieve?

- A. Individual end users managing their own personal tasks
- B. Internal team members coordinating shared work
- C. External customers of a product
- D. Just me (developer/personal use)
- E. Not identified
- X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. Individual end users managing their own personal tasks

## Q3. What does success look like? What metrics matter?

How will you know this app is doing its job?

- A. Users can add, complete, and delete todos reliably (functional success)
- B. Daily/weekly active usage
- C. Task completion rate
- D. It's simply usable and pleasant for the intended user
- E. Not yet defined
- X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. Users can add, complete, and delete todos reliably (functional success)

## Q4. What is the trigger for this initiative?

Why now — what prompted building this?

- A. Personal need / opportunity
- B. Learning React and want a hands-on project
- C. Prototype for a larger product idea
- D. Demo or portfolio piece
- E. Not applicable
- X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. Personal need / opportunity

## Q5. Who are the key stakeholders, and who decides scope or priority?

Beyond the end user, who has a stake in this, and who makes scope/priority calls?

- A. Just me — I decide scope and priorities
- B. Me plus a small group of intended users whose feedback matters
- C. A product owner or manager separate from the developer
- D. A team with defined roles (owner, designers, developers)
- E. Not identified
- X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. Just me — I decide scope and priorities

## Q6. Are there communication or reporting requirements?

Any cadence, status reporting, or stakeholder communication needs for this work?

- A. None — informal, no reporting needed
- B. Light — occasional check-ins with intended users
- C. Regular status updates to a stakeholder or team
- D. Not yet defined
- X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. None — informal, no reporting needed

- B. It's smaller than that — closer to a quick prototype/proof of concept
- C. It's larger — this is a broader product with more than todo management
- D. Not sure yet
